done_when: forge migrate keeps a file under an old-Forge folder when a tracked file outside the old-Forge folders references its path, and a test proves it

findings.body: If a tracked client file references a customized `.codex/skills/forge/SKILL.md`, this exclusion removes the skill from the backup plan. However, `_apply` still calls `sync.write` at `src/forge/migrate.py:745`; `src/forge/sync.py:271` supplies replacement content for that path, and lines 303–305 overwrite it. Migration therefore replaces the client's content without the `.forge-migrate/kept/` backup, despite reporting that the referenced file stays in place. Handle collisions with sync-generated files before excluding them from preservation, and cover this case through the migration command.
findings.title: Preserve referenced client content before sync overwrites it

why: forge migrate sets aside client-owned files that live under old-Forge folders, such as myclaw's bundled factory/skills/gantry-admin/SKILL.md, even when the client's code or package still references them
